displayName: OCI-AI-DB-006: AI — Database Prompt Injection via SQL
description:
Detects prompt injection attacks targeting AI-connected databases through SQL queries

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — database prompt injection via sql

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_006", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%database%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%') AND "value" > 0
